title: Tormentor
summary: TORMENT'OR, noun He or that which torments; one who inflicts penal anguish or tortures. 1. In agriculture, an instrument for reducing a stiff soil.

inlines.v: TORMENT'OR, noun He or that which torments; one who inflicts penal anguish or tortures. 1. In agriculture, an instrument for reducing a stiff soil.
